_help: Copy to eval/labels/<same name as the report file>.json. One entry per result row you want scored. value is required (as printed, or a number). unit, refLow, refHigh and flag are optional; flag is H, L or N (what a doctor would mark). Omit refLow/refHigh to skip range scoring for that row; use null for an open side, e.g. '< 200' is refLow null, refHigh 200.
